morning.title: Daybreak
morning.description: The first morning. Four strangers in a cramped apartment, all that remains of a dream that almost was.

messages.content: omg is this real?? we're actually doing this?? wait wait wait - who are you?? are you like... our manager or something??

choices.text: I'm here to help. We need to figure out our next steps together.
Something like that. Let's just get organized first.

messages.content: ohh okay!! that's actually really reassuring hehe~ so what's the plan?? do we have like... money?? food?? oh no do we have to cook??

choices.text: We'll figure out food. Right now, let's just talk and get to know each other.

messages.content: cool cool ok that's vague but ok☆
...so this is it then. The great disbandment.

choices.text: It's not over yet. There's always another path.
Look, we're all dealing with this. No need to be pessimistic.

messages.content: ...optimistic. i don't hate it.
whatever. just don't expect me to pretend.

noon.title: High Noon
noon.description: The reality sets in. Bills,饿肚子, and the weight of choices not made.

messages.content: okay i checked - we have exactly 47,000 won between us. that's like... two days of ramyeon. max.

choices.text: We need to find ways to make money. Any skills we can use?
Let's be careful. We'll make it work.

messages.content: i can dance - maybe teaching? sujin can sing, sohee is good at... stuff? miho can probably talk anyone into anything lol
on it!! tell me what to do and i'll make it happen!!
i've been thinking about our options. there are a few entertainment agencies still accepting applications for backup trainees. or we could look for part-time work.

choices.text: Backup trainees? That means starting over. Are you okay with that?
Let's look into both and decide together.

messages.content: if that's what you think is best. i just... i don't want to lose myself again.
i understand. please don't make us do anything reckless though.

night.title: After Dark
night.description: The first night together. Secrets surface. Trust is tested.

messages.content: well, well. look at this cute little gathering. didn't expect to find you all in one place.

choices.text: Who are you? How did you find us?
We're not interested in whatever you're selling.

messages.content: i can help you. i know people. there are ways back to the stage - easier ways than whatever fantasy you're all dreaming up... if you're interested.
oh but i think you are. you're all so desperate. it's almost sad. call me when you change your mind.
wait wait wait was that THE yuseong?? like from dreamwave?? omg what did he WANT??

choices.text: He wants to help, but I don't trust him. Stay away from him.
He might have connections. We should think about it.

messages.content: okay fine he seemed kinda creepy anyway... but what if he could really help??
right?? like we NEED help and he's like... actually connected?? this could be our way back!!

morning.title: Second Wind
morning.description: A new day brings new decisions. The group must decide on a direction.

messages.content: [The group chat lights up as everyone wakes up]

choices.text: Let's all talk about what we want for our future.
Focus on today. Let's see what we can do right now.

messages.content: okay so for me - i just want to perform!! i don't care how!! street performances, dance covers, ANYTHING!! just let me dance!!
...honestly i just want to disappear. disappear and not have anyone expect anything from me.

choices.text: That's understandable after everything. But you're not alone.

messages.content: ...thanks. i guess.

noon.title: The Heat
noon.description: Tensions rise as money problems become more urgent.

messages.content: hey so like... i found this ad? it's like a fan meeting thing but the money is really good?? but also like... it seems kinda weird??

choices.text: Show me the ad. We need to be careful about scams.
If it seems weird, let's skip it. We'll find something safer.

messages.content: okay so basically it's like - fans pay to get messages from ex-idols?? and it's like... kind of taboo?? the company got shut down for like... reasons??

choices.text: That's too risky. If our faces get out there, it could ruin future chances.
We might have to consider it if things get desperate.

messages.content: yeah you're probably right... it's just so hard to know what's real anymore☆
ugh FINE but like... we're really running out of options tho...
WAIT really?? you mean we might actually DO it?? ohmigod okay i can handle it just tell me what to do!!
i found a part-time job listing. it's at a convenience store - nothing glamorous, but it's honest work and the pay is reliable.

choices.text: That's perfect. Let's apply. All of us if they need people.

night.title: Shadows
night.description: Evening brings reflection. Some truths are harder than others.

messages.content: can i tell you something? in private?

choices.text: Of course. I'm here.

messages.content: there's this person. from before. they won't stop messaging me. they say they love me but i don't... i never asked for any of this.

choices.text: That's harassment. We should block them and document everything.
I'm sorry you're dealing with this. Do you want to talk about it more?

messages.content: i've already blocked like five accounts. they just make new ones. please... don't tell the others. i don't want them to worry.
thank you. it means a lot that you listened. i just... i need to feel like i have some control over my life again.
so. have you thought about my offer? i can make all your problems disappear. just one little thing in return...

choices.text: What exactly do you want?
We'll find our own way. Leave us alone.

messages.content: simple. you perform. i profit. we call it... 'consulting.' don't worry, no one will know. well. except everyone will. but that's the price, isn't it?
stubborn. i like it. for now. enjoy your poverty while it lasts.

morning.title: Turning Point
morning.description: A choice must be made. The group faces its first major decision.

messages.content: [The apartment is quiet. Everyone has something on their mind.]

choices.text: We need to decide our path. Let's have an honest discussion.

messages.content: okay so i was thinking - what if we made our OWN content?? dance covers, vlogs, anything!! we have skills!! we just need a platform!!

choices.text: That's a great idea! We could start small and build an audience.
It takes time to build an audience. We need something more immediate.

messages.content: YESSSS i knew you'd get it!! don't worry i'll work super hard!! just tell me what to create first!!
i know i know... but still... it's not fair. we worked so hard and now we have to start from zero again...
whatever you decide. just don't expect me to be in any videos. i didn't leave one prison to step into another.

choices.text: That's fair. No one will pressure you to do anything you're uncomfortable with.

messages.content: ...thank you. i mean it.

noon.title: Crossroads
noon.description: An unexpected visitor brings news that will change everything.

messages.content: changing your minds yet? the clock is ticking. your little 'honest work' won't save you forever.

choices.text: We don't need your help. We're going to make it on our own.
What exactly are you offering? Tell me more.

messages.content: brave. foolish, but brave. we'll see how long that lasts.
now you're thinking. i have connections. private events, exclusive parties, 'entertainment' for wealthy clients. the money is incredible. and all you have to do is... perform. like you were meant to.

choices.text: That sounds like...

messages.content: don't overthink it. just know the offer is on the table. for all of you. especially that eager one - hyunju, was it?
wait what?? me?? i wasn't - i didn't say anything!!

choices.text: Ignore him. He's just trying to manipulate us.
Are you okay, Hyunju? This seems to have affected you.

messages.content: yeah yeah you're right okay!! let's just... let's just focus on something else.
i'm fine!! really!! i just... i don't know. it felt like he could see right through me. it's scary.

night.title: Revelation
night.description: The day ends with a shocking discovery about the company's true fate.

messages.content: okay so i may have done a bad thing. i may have like... looked up what happened to our company?? and UM.

choices.text: What did you find?

messages.content: so like... it wasn't just mismanagement. there was like... fraud?? and SOMEONE sold us out to the media. the whole thing was planned. we were set up.

choices.text: Who? Who sold us out?
We can't trust everything we read online. Let's not jump to conclusions.

messages.content: i don't KNOW that's the worst part!! but there are like... rumors. and they all point to someone high up. someone who left BEFORE everything went down.
i know right?? but also the evidence was like... really detailed?? this isn't just random rumors??
yuseong. it was yuseong. i saw him meeting with reporters. i saw him smile.

choices.text: Are you sure? This is a serious accusation.

messages.content: positive. he sold us. he made money off our dreams. and now he wants to buy us back for parts. that's who we're dealing with.
